description_html:
Key Features

  • Andosol-Mix Rooting Box: Utilizes nutrient-rich andosol soil mix for optimal plant growth and healthy root development.
  • Large Growing Area: Offers a spacious 33 square metre cultivation space, suitable for high-density planting and maximizing yield.
  • Consistent Root Zone Temperature: Maintains a stable 21°C (69.8°F) root zone temperature, ideal for promoting vigorous root activity and reducing plant stress.
  • High Capacity: Equipped with 459 individual plant slots, enabling efficient organization and scalability for both commercial and hobby growers.
  • Extended Growth Cycle: Supports a 190-day growth cycle, allowing for a wide range of crops and maximizing seasonal productivity.
  • Passive Capillary Irrigation: Features a low-maintenance, water-efficient passive capillary irrigation system for consistent moisture delivery to each plant slot.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Plant Health: The andosol-mix medium and controlled root temperature foster robust root systems, leading to healthier, faster-growing plants.
  • Optimized Space Utilization: With 459 planting slots in a 33 m² area, users can increase plant density without compromising growth quality.
  • Energy and Water Efficiency: Passive capillary irrigation minimizes water waste and reduces the need for active watering systems, lowering operational costs.
  • Reliable and Consistent Results: Stable environmental conditions and long cycle duration ensure predictable outcomes and reduce crop variability.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined after acceptance, allowing tailored solutions based on specific requirements and order size.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Commercial Greenhouses: Ideal for large-scale vegetable, herb, or ornamental plant production seeking efficient space and resource management.
  • Urban Farming Projects: Suitable for rooftop gardens or indoor farms needing high-density, low-maintenance growing solutions.
  • Research and Educational Facilities: Perfect for controlled plant growth experiments requiring consistent root zone conditions and easy plant slot tracking.
  • Home Gardeners: Beneficial for enthusiasts aiming to maximize home cultivation in limited spaces with minimal irrigation effort.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is it easy to set up and maintain? Yes, the passive capillary irrigation system simplifies watering and reduces manual labor.
  • Is the system compatible with different plant types? The versatile slot design and andosol-mix substrate accommodate a variety of crops, from leafy greens to flowering plants.
  • How durable is the rooting box? Constructed for long-term use, the unit is designed to withstand repeated growing cycles and varying environmental conditions.
  • What value does this system offer? By combining high plant capacity, efficient irrigation, and optimal root conditions, users achieve greater yields with less resource expenditure.
